text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki and her Trainer search for a 
way to overcome the pressure. Seeking 
clues, the two watch a DVD featuring Fuji 
Kiseki's mother.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She should be feeling the pressure as a 
stage actor as well, yet she didn't show 
it at all. Fuji Kiseki wondered why that 
could be...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer suggests, "Let's go talk to 
her directly." The two decide to go meet 
Fuji Kiseki's mother.
